name: Hokuhoku Financial Group, Inc.
summary: Hokuhoku Financial Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services to individuals, and small and medium-sized enterprises. The company provides financial instruments, M&A advisory work, business succession consulting work, management consulting work, credit card operations, loan guarantees, software development, venture capital, document management, concentrated business processing, maintenance, ICT infrastructure construction, cash management and settlement, concentrated business processing, economic surveys, survey and research services, and consulting services.
